posts.name: HyNote for Mac

posts.description: Solving the three biggest pain points in meeting software: privacy, friction, and cost. By running speech-to-text entirely on-device, your confidential discussions never leave your hardware, ensuring total data privacy. It operates invisibly without sending an awkward bot into your attendee list, capturing system audio directly across Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams.

posts.name: Grok 4.6
posts.tagline: Frontier Intelligence for Long-Running Agents
posts.description: Continuous reasoning meets real-world execution. Grok 4.6 brings major upgrades to agentic workflows, software engineering, and interactive web application generation—at an unchanged, cost-efficient rate of $2 / $6 per 1M tokens. Build long-running AI agent workflows with Grok 4.6 on xAI API and partner networks!

posts.name: Checksum AI
posts.tagline: Your coding agent’s testing buddy
posts.description: Checksum is an AI-native continuous testing platform for engineering teams shipping faster than manual QA can keep up. It generates, runs, and auto-heals end-to-end and API tests on every pull request, all as standard Playwright code in your own repo. When a test fails, Checksum tells you whether it found a real bug or a stale test, then fixes the false failures so your suite keeps pace with your coding agents.

posts.name: The New Calendly
posts.tagline: Handle all of the work before, during, and after meetings
posts.description: Meet Calendly Notetaker and Callie AI assistant: two new AI products built to handle the work before, during, and after meetings. Meetings are essential, but the work around them adds up fast. 😅 That's why we're launching an evolved Calendly. One that handles not just scheduling, but all of the work before, during, and after your meetings, so you can focus on what matters.

posts.name: MeetStream AI
posts.tagline: Unified API & Infra for AI Meeting Agents
posts.description: Agent-first infrastructure for meetings. One API to capture 50+ real-time data points from Zoom, Google Meet, and Teams, with built-in voice infrastructure so your agent joins as a participant, listens, speaks, and acts while the call is happening.

posts.name: Prized
posts.tagline: Let non-engineers build secure internal tools
posts.description: Prized lets ops, support, and finance teams build and ship secure internal tools with AI. Company data pre-connected and scoped, an audit trail on every access, one-click deploy behind your company sign-in.

posts.name: Lifelong
posts.tagline: Your whole family’s health in one place.
posts.description: Lifelong is the family health app built around the household, not just one person. Keep records, medications, symptoms, appointments, activity and sleep together for everyone you care about. Connect the wearables you already use, keep the right people in the loop, and use Alo, the in-app AI companion, to log updates and take simple actions. Sharing stays user-controlled. Available on iOS with a two-week free trial.

posts.name: MiniMax Design
posts.tagline: Your own agent team for open-ended creation
posts.description: MiniMax Design is a desktop app that wraps MiniMax H3 in a full production workflow. Describe the video, and agents handle the brief, stills, H3 clips, music, and edit on one canvas. Skills, a 3D director stage, and ComfyUI nodes stay there when you want more control.

posts.name: Glasp for Firefox
posts.tagline: Highlight and summarize any page, PDF, or video in Firefox
posts.description: Glasp is now on Firefox. Highlight web articles, PDFs, and YouTube transcripts in four colors, add notes and tags, and summarize any page or video with ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini. Everything lands in one searchable library and exports to Notion, Obsidian, or Markdown. Sign in on any browser or on the mobile apps and your highlights follow you. Free, and nothing to migrate.

posts.name: Aloud
posts.tagline: Turn spoken feedback into tasks your coding agent can run
posts.description: Feedback is easier said than written. Aloud records your voice, your screen and a live transcript together while you talk through your app – pointing at things, changing your mind. Then one press: it rewrites the transcript into what you actually meant, asks about anything that could be read two ways, pulls the screenshots you were pointing at, and turns the session into tasks for Claude Code, Cursor or Codex. Whisper runs on-device – your audio and video never leave the Mac.

posts.name: Shape
posts.tagline: The agentic IDE for designers and programmers
posts.description: Shape is the agentic IDE for designers and programmers. Design, code, Git, and AI chat in one desktop app. Download for Windows.

posts.name: NobodyWho
posts.tagline: Run AI models on any device
posts.description: NobodyWho is an inference engine for running LLMs fully on-device, built on llama.cpp. Open-source, free, no API keys, no cloud calls. We support Swift, Kotlin, Flutter, React Native, Python, and Godot. Includes type-safe tool calling with automatic grammar generation, multimodal input, Text-to-Speech & Speech-to-Text, GPU acceleration via Vulkan & Metal, and Hugging Face model downloads.

posts.name: bitdrift.ai
posts.tagline: The world’s first agentic mobile observability platform
posts.description: bitdrift AI is the world’s first agentic mobile observability platform: a real-time, full-fidelity observability system that lets AI agents query mobile user behavior and act on it autonomously. It's built on the bitdrift Public API and bd skills. User journeys, performance metrics, and behavioral changes are all available when your agent needs them, not ten days later waiting for an app release. Early users of bitdrift AI report faster investigations and a 10x improvement in MTTR.

posts.name: Berd
posts.tagline: Weird, playful desktop app for building with AI agents
posts.description: Berd is for people doing real work with AI agents inside a desktop workspace: engineers, product designers, and other builders who need a persistent agent companion that can use projects, skills, extensions, automations, model providers, and local workspace context. Users are often moving between broad product thinking and concrete implementation, so the interface needs to support fast chat, precise context selection, and confidence about what the agent can see or do.

posts.name: Hermai Brand API
posts.tagline: White label your B2B SaaS with every customer's brand
posts.description: A customer signs up with a work email or domain. You get back the logo, colors, description, and a ready to apply theme. Built for B2B SaaS so every customer's account looks like theirs from the first login. Free for 1,000 brands a month, every month. No card.

posts.name: Zoho Cliq 7.0
posts.tagline: Uninterrupted work
posts.description: Connect the dots and do uninterrupted work with our latest features and enhancements. Build no-code bots, experience inclusive collaboration with sign language mode for meetings and WCAG compliance, and focus on the little things that keep work flowing—multimedia summaries, AI coding assistant, hashtags and more.

posts.name: Peach Co-Pilot
posts.tagline: WhatsApp Sidekick for busy professionals

posts.name: Roveri
posts.tagline: A riding journal for iPhone every ride, painted on a map
posts.description: One tap records the route, speed, elevation and the weather of every ride, painted on a map. Rides add up into seasons you can re-open — and an atlas of every road you've ever ridden. A journal, not a navigator. Free to start; iPhone, iOS 18.6+.

posts.name: Revy
posts.tagline: The ownership layer for fashion, shopping, and your wardrobe
posts.description: Revy is the fashion app for recreating the looks you love, using the wardrobe you already own, while connecting inspiration, creators, shopping, and personal style.

posts.name: ProtoNote
posts.tagline: Share AI-built prototypes, get feedback pinned to the page
posts.description: Drop in an HTML prototype, image, or PDF and get a shareable link. Reviewers leave notes pinned to the exact spot on the page. No account required, just a name. Use the Claude connector to turn anything you build into a ProtoNote right inside the chat. When notes come in, tell Claude to pull them in and apply the changes. The new version publishes itself. Free tier includes 3 active prototypes with unlimited reviewers and notes. Reviewing is always free.

posts.name: Cloudways Managed AI Agents
posts.tagline: Skip the setup and run OpenClaw & Hermes, fully managed
posts.description: AI agents like OpenClaw and Hermes are easy to run, but hard to host well. Cloudways Managed AI Agents runs OpenClaw or Hermes on isolated, secured infrastructure with validated updates that keep your agent stable. Bring your LLM key and deploy in minutes.

posts.name: NXS by Aliensense
posts.tagline: A sensor board that gets your robot running in minutes
posts.description: NXS is a plug-and-play sensor board for robots – it handles the wiring and driver setup automatically, so cameras and sensors are streaming usable data in minutes instead of weeks. It connects over GMSL or CAN-FD and works with the MikroElektronika Click ecosystem of sensors, with ROS 2 topics available through the included host bridge.

posts.name: Stateshift
posts.tagline: Rewire Your Anxiety in 15 Days
posts.description: Stateshift is designed to guide you through practices that address the root cause of anxiety, not just the surface level symptoms. Within just 15 days of practice, you can learn to regulate your anxiety so that you can spend time with friends, be there for your family, and enjoy your work again.

posts.name: Bookmarx
posts.tagline: Make your X bookmarks useful again
posts.description: Your X bookmarks are full of useful things you probably forgot about. Bookmarx helps you use them. Connect X once and keep bookmarking as usual. Bookmarx automatically syncs your saves, summarizes and organizes them, lets you search or chat in plain language, turns long reads into visual decks, and reminds you to revisit what matters. No extension. No manual filing. No new habit.

posts.name: Rubric
posts.tagline: UX expertise your agent can call
posts.description: Coding agents ship UI fast, but they design from vibes. Rubric gives them a source: 554 curated UX rules with severity, evidence and a concrete fix, served over MCP. One corpus, two moments. Before you build, your agent pulls prescriptive guidance, not generic best practices. After you ship, it audits the live site against the same rules and returns findings ranked by severity: issue, impact, actions, references. Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Cline. Browser approval, no API keys.

posts.name: Tidy Folders
posts.tagline: Folders & text highlights for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini & more
posts.description: Tidy finally organizes your AI chats in one folder library, across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek and Grok. Highlight key answers in long threads and each one becomes a link back to the exact spot. Save regular bookmarks in the same folder structure, so chats and sources sit together. Chats you started in the mobile or desktop apps can be flagged for filing too. Start free for Chrome, Edge, Firefox and Safari.

posts.name: Makers Page
posts.tagline: Ranked by streak, not revenue.
posts.description: Most directories rank you by revenue you can screenshot. makers.page ranks you by a streak you can't fake: show up and check in daily to stay on the leaderboard. Free listing includes a public page, dofollow backlink, and sitemap inclusion. Self-host the open-source Marketing MCP to draft your launch posts, you approve before anything goes live.

posts.name: Tucan
posts.tagline: No streaks. A quiet dot grid for daily habits.
posts.description: Most habit apps punish you when you miss a day. Tucan doesn't. It's a binary tracker: done or not. The hero is a monochrome dot grid of your history. One tap, works offline. Miss a day and the hole just sits there. Nothing resets. I built it because streaks made me hide from the app after a Tuesday. That's the opposite of a habit. 7-day free trial, then $1.99/mo or $8.99/year. No feature gates. iOS.

posts.name: Velvet UI
posts.tagline: Native-feeling sheets and toasts for React
posts.description: Velvet UI is a headless React library for sheets and toasts that feel at home on every device. Browser-native WAAPI animations and custom physics power fluid dragging, scrolling, snapping, touch gestures, trackpad swipes, mouse-wheel input, and interruptible motion. It is accessible, deeply customizable, tree-shakeable, and dependency-free beyond React. Use it with your own styles or with Base UI, Radix UI, and React Aria.

posts.name: Dehurdle
posts.tagline: Win the meeting before it starts.
posts.description: Most important conversations go wrong because we practice on real people. Dehurdle lets you practice tough conversations out loud with realistic AI characters that talk, interrupt, and challenge you in real time. • Practice salary talks, tough 1-on-1s, client pushback, and pitches • Live screen alerts when you speak too fast or ramble for too long • Honest transcript breakdown showing the exact sentence you lost them, and what to say instead Practice on AI. Perform on People.

posts.name: Hatchable
posts.tagline: Build real apps with your AI. We make them work.
posts.description: Point your agent at Hatchable, whatever it builds just works and you get a live URL. Hatchable is a complete cloud with hosting, database, login, email, cron, custom domains and more. Everything your AI agent needs to build real apps, in one place. No AI credits to buy, you already pay for your AI. Connect your Claude or any coding agent to Hatchable over MCP, tell it what to build, we make it work.

posts.name: Dungeons & Dilutions — a fundraising RPG
posts.tagline: Roll a d20 to raise $2M. The VCs are the monsters.
posts.description: You're a founder who just landed in San Francisco: $40,000, an air mattress, and 26 weeks to close a $2M seed round. Meetings are the combat. 15 investor types, each with its own encounter - the AI Doomer Fund asks your p(doom) before your name, the Family Office won't invest on a first meeting, and an anonymous frog with $8M sends voice notes at 3am. Roll d20 against Charisma, Tech, Hustle and Vision. Six endings. Free, no signup, one HTML file.

posts.name: Quick Metadata Remover
posts.tagline: Protect your privacy with one simple drop
posts.description: Quick Metadata Remover removes hidden metadata from your photos, including EXIF, IPTC, XMP, GPS data, and comments. Just drag and drop your photos or an entire folder, confirm, and remove metadata in seconds. Your file names and folder structure stay intact.

posts.name: Arcadely
posts.tagline: Free browser games instantly, no download or signup needed
posts.description: Arcadely is free browser gaming with zero friction: no downloads, no accounts, no app store. Click a link and you're playing arcade, puzzle, word, and casual games, with leaderboards if you're competitive. Two things make it different: multiplayer works by sharing a link (challenge a friend to Word Tiles, our Scrabble-style game, in one click), and games keep working offline once loaded it's perfect for subway commutes and spotty wifi. New games ship regularly.

posts.name: ShortenItUp
posts.tagline: Cuts your meetings in half, not just records them
posts.description: Most meeting tools record what went wrong. ShortenItUp prevents it. It joins your call, keeps everyone on the agenda with real-time off-topic nudges, and checks whether a meeting even needs to happen - before it starts. Tasks get auto-assigned to Notion, Jira, or Asana the moment the call ends. Unlike Meeting N*tetakers we don't just record bad meetings. We stop them

posts.name: Starko Turn support into growth

posts.description: Starko is an omnichannel customer support software and AI helpdesk platform. Unify WhatsApp, Instagram, email, and Slack into a single customer service platform with AI-powered automation, knowledge base software, and ticketing system. Where AI agents automatically code new features and fix bugs for you.

posts.name: Embent

posts.description: Embent is an AI agent for your website. It answers visitors only from your own pages — with citations under every answer — captures leads, says "I don't know" instead of inventing, and logs every question it couldn't answer so you know exactly which page to write next. Try it without signing up: paste your URL on embent.com and a preview bot built from your own site is answering in about a minute.

Every template is carefully selected, and purchases are made directly through each creator’s own store.

posts.name: FluxTwin AI

posts.description: FluxTwin AI is a web-based thermal intelligence platform that instantly predicts data center thermal behavior as IT workloads and cooling conditions change. Unlike traditional CFD simulations that take hours or days, FluxTwin AI delivers physics-informed thermal predictions in seconds. Analyze hotspots, validate N+1 redundancy, ensure ASHRAE compliance, monitor virtual sensors, and understand environmental impact through an interactive 3D digital twin.

posts.name: supaintro
posts.tagline: Turn your product URL into a polished launch film
posts.description: Paste your product URL and a sentence about what you do. supaintro learns your brand, writes an editable storyline, and renders a 60-second motion-graphics launch film with music, voice-over, captions, and landscape and portrait exports. Review the draft for free; pay only when you’re ready to render.

posts.name: Rentnation
posts.tagline: A richup like browser monopoly game
posts.description: Build your property empire in RentNation, a free multiplayer property trading game. Play with up to 8 friends in your browser — no download, no account.

posts.name: Smartphone Zombies (Smombies)

posts.description: You have seen them. We all have. People walking towards you, eyes fixed on their phones, unaware of what is happening around them. We call them Smartphone Zombies. They move through public space, but their attention belongs to the screen. Our stickers turn this everyday behavior into a public intervention: a simple, provocative reminder to look up. Download, print and place one in your city, or write to us and get stickers from us.

posts.name: WhatsChat — WhatsApp conversations
posts.tagline: Turn website visitors into WhatsApp conversations
posts.description: Turn website visitors into WhatsApp conversations 💬 WhatsChat adds a smart WhatsApp widget to your website — no API, no code, no complicated setup. Trigger conversations based on exit intent, time on page, scroll depth, specific pages, and more. Set it up in under 2 minutes and start chatting with visitors directly from WhatsApp. Free to start. Pro is just €8/month. Your visitors are already on WhatsApp. Meet them there.

posts.name: Invora
posts.tagline: Turn one-line briefs into quotes, invoices & payments
posts.description: Invora turns a one-line brief into a client-ready quotation, converts it to an invoice in a click, and chases the payment for you. Built by Vertex Infotech.

posts.name: Fiamo
posts.tagline: One tiny real-life quest a day. Then it tells you to leave.
posts.description: Fiamo gives everyone on Earth the same tiny real-life quest each day - like giving a stranger an honest compliment, or eating one meal without your phone. Mark it done, watch a live counter of everyone doing today's quest with you, then Fiamo tells you to close the app and go live your life. No feed, no login, nothing to scroll. Just one small nudge back into the real world, every day, for free.

posts.name: Birds on Watch
posts.tagline: Every Loudmouth Snoozed
posts.description: A free browser game where you're a bird over a city that will not shut up. Car alarms, sirens going nowhere, leaf blowers, someone's party. Find the racket, drop on it, earn the silence back. Four cities, 90 seconds a round, no signup. Sound on.

posts.name: Aristra AI
posts.tagline: Don't judge a book by its cover, Sign up and discover
posts.description: Most AI cares only about the outcome users want. Aristra cares about your process. It works alongside and for you across the things you already use, learning about you and from you, day and night. What works becomes a playbook it reaches for next time. What stops being true quietly fades. How you actually get things done is the most valuable thing about you, and it's the one thing no AI understands. One AI. One memory. Your life OS.

posts.tagline: Decentralized universal computer
posts.description: A decentralized universal computer: every machine is a folder under /, cd computer, (Plan 9 + TLS, in Go) - Skills03/universal-computer

posts.description: You can solve the problem, then blank the second you explain it out loud. That's what interviews test. Practice hands-free in the minutes you'd scroll away: subway, taxi, between meetings. No laptop, no desk. 7-day trial, no weekly-plan dark patterns.

posts.name: IhateLaTeX
posts.tagline: Free, private in-browser, no-code LaTeX resume & CV builder

posts.description: Today, BReminder is a simple and beautiful birthday reminder. Next, we're building it into a birthday-focused social network — a place to remember, celebrate, share memories, discover gift ideas, and stay connected around the dates that matter most. https://breminder.com

posts.name: ScriptGrain - Write like you, at scale
posts.tagline: AI writing that sounds like you. Measured, not guessed.
posts.description: Every AI tool writes in the same confident, anonymous voice. Yours doesn't have to. ScriptGrain doesn't guess your style from a prompt: it measures 45 stylometric reference points from writing you've already done, holds every draft to those constraints, and scores each one against your profile. Miss the voice? A polish loop revises toward you, not generic-good. See your full profile free, no card. UK-built, UK English as standard, API + MCP server included.

posts.name: Zelcast Eng Scorer
posts.tagline: Your LinkedIn, scored the way startups actually hire
posts.description: Eng Scorer reads your LinkedIn the way a hungry, fast-growing startup actually would. Watch the dollars fly. There’s a live leaderboard of the top 100 working engineers (upvotes break the ties). The alumni page shows exactly where the talent is flowing and which companies keep producing the good ones.

posts.name: gud CRM
posts.tagline: Calm, open-source, voice-input sales CRM for small teams
posts.description: gud CRM keeps the work before a client says yes clear: ideas, researched targets, contacts, opportunities, conversations and the next useful action. Choose a focused single-offer setup or a flexible service-business workspace. Capture opportunities and updates by voice, use optional AI coaching and connect Codex-compatible assistants through MCP. It is open source, self-hostable and designed to feel useful without traditional CRM bloat.

posts.name: MlookD

posts.description: MlookD is a free online Markdown (.md) viewer. Drop or open amd file to preview it instantly — headings, tables, code blocks, links, images — right in your browser. No upload, no install, no sign-up.

posts.name: ARVIS

posts.description: ARVIS for Mac: privacy-first local AI. Control your Mac with voice and hands. One-time $10, yours forever.

posts.name: Brieflet

posts.description: Brieflet reads the sources you choose and turns them into one calm daily brief for your work and interests. It filters what matters, writes for what you already know, remembers your feedback, shows what it skipped, and lets you listen on the go.

posts.name: Blume

posts.description: Blume is a mobile app for saving recipes, running a precise brew timer, logging every cup, and exploring single origins. Download it on Google Play.

Simply upload a screenshot from any dating app, and ScanFakes analyzes the photos and publicly available information to identify potential signs of stolen identities, fake profiles, or catfishing—returning an easy-to-understand Fake Score in under a minute.

posts.name: Bankflow
posts.tagline: Turn bank & credit card statements into clean data
posts.description: Just upload your bank or credit card statement PDF — no setup, no templates to configure. BankFlow turns it into clean, organized data in seconds: transactions auto-tagged by merchant and category, visualized in an interactive spend map so you instantly see where your money goes. Possible duplicates get flagged for your review, and every transaction links back to its exact spot in the source PDF. Free to start, simple credit-based plans after that.

posts.name: OrderBee

posts.description: OrderBee forecasts demand and tells you exactly what to reorder, how much, and when. It connects sales and inventory data from tools like Shopify and other systems, then turns that into clear reorder guidance so founders can avoid stockouts and excess inventory without living in spreadsheets. Works with Shopify, Moneybird, WeFact and CSV. Built in Amsterdam.

posts.name: Slack Code

posts.description: Don’t code alone. Slack Code is live. Humans and agents. Same channel. Same work. Launching today with agents from @AnthropicAI, @github, @Cognition, and @vercel.

posts.name: Fraym

posts.description: Fraym is automatic AI demo software for Mac and Windows. Give it a link, tell it what to show, and its AI agents performs the demo inside your product, records itself, and produces a polished video — cinematic auto-zoom, smooth cursor, AI voiceover, and captions. Every other tool records what you do. Fraym does it for you. Because the AI knows exactly what it's clicking, the camera lands perfectly on every action instead of guessing. You can still record manually Fraym edits it either way.

posts.name: OpenLibreNet

posts.description: Browse anonymously from six regions, unblock geo-restricted sites, and share a live session with your team. Free, with nothing to install and no account to create.
